subject: Request: evidence for UK Addendum / SCCs for EU/UK transfer
messages:
From: Sofia Grimaldi <sofia.grimaldi@europa-health.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Thomas Reid <thomas.reid@europa-health.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Evidence for transfers — SCCs / UK Addendum

Hi Neha / Karthik,

Quick intro — I’m Sofia from Europa Health’s legal/compliance team. We’re getting close to a procurement sign-off but our internal privacy team needs a short package confirming the transfer safeguards Redwood will rely on for EU/UK personal data:

- Do you intend to rely on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for EEA->US transfers, the UK IDTA (UK Addendum), or a combination?
- If SCCs/UK Addendum, can you provide the current draft(s) and indicate any non-standard redlines Redwood will propose?
- Does Redwood currently maintain a third-party subprocessors list we can review that covers processing in the US and APAC?
- Please confirm whether you have a completed Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA/DTIA) for the models/workloads that will process our data. If so, can you share the summary or high-level mitigations?

If helpful, Thomas and I can accept a short call with your privacy team this week — we’d like to close this prior to the legal review.

Thanks,
Sofia Grimaldi
Legal Counsel, Data Protection
Europa Health
sofia.grimaldi@europa-health.com

[attachment: none]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Grimaldi <sofia.grimaldi@europa-health.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence for transfers — SCCs / UK Addendum

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Monica (Privacy Counsel) and Laura (Head of Privacy Ops) to provide the detailed artifacts.

In short: Redwood typically offers SCCs for EEA transfers + a UK Addendum (we aim to align with the ICO’s guidance). For enterprise customers we:
- Provide the standard SCCs executed between customer and Redwood (or a DPA incorporating the SCC terms)
- Offer the UK IDTA / UK Addendum as an addendum where customers require UK-specific wording
- Produce a Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA/DTIA) summary for higher-risk configurations and model types

I’ve attached our working draft of the UK Addendum (UK_Addendum_Draft_v2.pdf) and a short SCCs summary sheet (SCCs_Summary.xlsx) to start. Welcome Thomas’ input on any commercial/legal redlines.

Next steps I propose:
1) Monica to review the drafts and call out any vendor redlines
2) If Europa needs a formal TIA summary for the specific model set, Laura will confirm timeline (usually 5–7 business days)
3) We can do a 30-minute sync with your legal team — suggest Fri 6 Mar or Mon 9 Mar (please share availability)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Accounts — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: UK_Addendum_Draft_v2.pdf, SCCs_Summary.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Grimaldi <sofia.grimaldi@europa-health.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence for transfers — SCCs / UK Addendum

Hi Sofia — thanks, and hi Neha. I reviewed the draft UK Addendum and the SCCs summary you sent. A few actionable items / questions from privacy counsel:

1) Redlines: I prepared high-level redline suggestions (attached: Redlines_Monika_20260305.docx). Most are clarifications (scope of processing, subprocessors clause, and liability carve-outs).

2) Subprocessors: Please confirm the most recent subprocessors registry for the account. I have a general list (Subprocessors_List_202602.pdf) that covers our common infra vendors, but we need to confirm there are no account-specific subprocessors.

3) TIA/DTIA: For Europa Health’s requested workload (model class: instruction-tuned LLMs, inference in shared-hosted hosted environment), our TIA indicates medium transfer risk for remote execution + logging. Mitigations we document in the TIA summary:
   - contractual safeguards: SCCs + UK Addendum where applicable
   - technical controls: TLS in transit, optional customer-managed KMS for keys, token redaction at edge
   - operational controls: retention limits, enterprise routing to EU-dedicated capacity where requested

We can produce a one-page TIA summary specific to Europa’s planned config — estimate 4 business days once Europa confirms environments and whether dedicated capacity will be used.

4) Data retention / logging: please confirm whether Europa requires longer retention for audit logs or model telemetry — that affects the TIA recommendations.

Would Europa accept tracked change redlines to the UK Addendum so we can iterate rather than start from scratch? If yes, I’ll send the redline version and we can schedule a 30-minute legal-to-legal call.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Privacy Counsel | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redlines_Monika_20260305.docx, Subprocessors_List_202602.pdf

From: Sofia Grimaldi <sofia.grimaldi@europa-health.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Thomas Reid <thomas.reid@europa-health.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 16:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence for transfers — SCCs / UK Addendum

Thanks, Monica — that is helpful. We can proceed with the tracked-redline approach. A few clarifications from our side:

- Europa prefers SCCs + UK Addendum (IDTA) where possible; we will mark any non-starters in your redlines.
- On subprocessors: we need the full list that will process Europa data (including cloud infra regions) — the Subprocessors_List_202602.pdf is a good start, but please confirm whether any additional subcontractors are used for model hosting/monitoring.
- For the TIA: the one-page summary you proposed is acceptable. Please include the mitigations and whether dedicated EU capacity is feasible (we're evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted).

Next steps:
1) Monica to send tracked redlines to the UK_Addendum (please share via DocuSign or secure Drive)
2) Neha to upload the final DPA + SCCs to our HubSpot record and share the link
3) Europa legal to review redlines and propose any countered text within 3 business days

Availability for the sync: Mon 9 Mar 09:00–11:00 GMT works for our legal team. Could you please confirm? Also please include a DocuSign envelope if Redwood prefers that signing route.

Best regards,
Sofia Grimaldi
Legal Counsel, Data Protection
Europa Health
sofia.grimaldi@europa-health.com
